correctness.rationale: PASS. For nonempty finite triangle-free H and t≥5, write k=t−2≥3 and S for s clique vertices. For a face containing j center vertices, all H subsets are allowed for j≤k−1, only independent H subsets when j=k, and only the empty H subset when j=k+1. Thus X=L_{k−2}*Δ_H ∪ L_{k−1}*Ind(H) ∪ L_k, an exact face decomposition (L_r is the r-skeleton of Δ_S). For s<k, X is a full simplex and both binomial coefficients vanish. For s≥k, A=L_{k−2}*Δ_H is contractible since H nonempty; the simplicial inclusion is a CW cofibration, so X≃X/A. Relative to A, each k-center face F contributes a quotient (Δ_F*I)/(∂Δ_F*I)≃Σ^k|I|; distinct k-face blocks meet in collapsed A. For k≥3 the wedge of these iterated suspensions is (k−1)-connected for arbitrary nonempty I, so boundary S^{k−1} maps of the binomial(s,k+1) new k-cells are null, each adding an S^k. The result is an actual nonequivariant integral homotopy wedge, including possible shifted torsion, not just an F2 Betti equality. Independently checked exact graph/clique face construction and mod-two reduced homology for three nontrivial sample joins H=P3,C4,C5 and correct center ranges; the source verifier enumerates broader finite families, but these cannot certify integral torsion or infinite parameters. The proof, rather than a log, supplies that. t=4 is explicitly excluded as previously published.
